constellations.summary: Universal Energy Battery and burst DPS empowering party bursts while unleashing Musou Shinsetsu slashes.
Gains Resolve stacks 80% faster from Electro bursts and 20% faster from other elemental bursts.
Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu and Musou Isshin attacks ignore 60% of opponents' DEF (+44% personal damage jump).
Grants +30% ATK to all party members for 10s after Burst state ends.
Attacks during Burst decrease all party members' Burst cooldowns by up to 5s.
